goals: Verify that the `addListStyle` function correctly applies bulleted and numbered list formatting to the input text, including sequential numbering for numbered lists, and updates the cursor position accordingly.
Verify that the `addListStyle` function does not modify the input element when no list style is provided.
activities: Initialize an element object with value 'test' and selection at the beginning.
Call 'addListStyle' function with the element and a null list style.
Assert that the element's value remains 'test'.
Assert that the element's selectionStart remains 0.
Assert that the element's selectionEnd remains 0.
Initialize an element object with value 'test\n' and selection at the end.
Call 'addListStyle' function with the element and 'BULLETED' list style.
Assert that the returned value is 'test\n- '.
Assert that the returned selectionStart is at the end of the new value.
Initialize an element object with value 'test\ntest' and selection in the middle.
Call 'addListStyle' function with the element and 'BULLETED' list style.
Assert that the returned value is 'test\n- test'.
Assert that the returned selectionStart is correctly positioned after the bullet.
Initialize an element object with value 'test\n' and selection at the end.
Call 'addListStyle' function with the element and 'NUMBERED' list style.
Assert that the returned value is 'test\n1. '.
Assert that the returned selectionStart is at the end of the new value.
Initialize an element object with value 'test\n1. \n' and selection at the end of the second line.
Call 'addListStyle' function with the element and 'NUMBERED' list style.
Assert that the returned value is 'test\n1. \n2. '.
Assert that the returned selectionStart is at the end of the new value.
Initialize an element object with value 'test\n\ntest' and selection on the empty line.
Call 'addListStyle' function with the element and 'NUMBERED' list style.
Assert that the returned value is 'test\n1. \ntest'.
Assert that the returned selectionStart is correctly positioned after the number.
